name: Multi-Repo Git Overview

cover.alt: Multi-Repo Git Overview: every repository of a folder in one panel, with pending changes, ahead/behind and branch mismatches

screenshots.alt: Summary bar (5 repos, 3 with changes, 1 behind, 1 ahead) over the five repos, with the commit graph and a commit's files of the selected repo
screenshots.caption: All the repos of a folder at once: pending changes, ahead/behind, branch, and the history of the one you pick

description: For a folder of independent git repos, each with its own .git and no shared parent. See which have pending changes, are behind their remote or sit on a different branch, and fetch them all in one click. Orca's native Source Control covers attached worktrees; this covers plain sub-repos.

settings.title: Container folder
settings.description: Absolute path of a folder whose direct children are git repositories. Used only when the active workspace does not contain repositories.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Interface language. Auto follows the system language.
